# AlecsDesign

> Independent web studio in Rome, Italy building fast, multilingual websites, online booking/payment flows, custom client tools, and plain-English digital help for people who want a real solution, not jargon.

## Best fit
- Small businesses that need a website that looks credible, loads fast, and helps them get inquiries.
- Service businesses that need bookings, payments, or other simple client flows.
- People who are stuck with a digital problem and want direct human help.

## High-intent pages
- [Home](https://www.alecsdesign.xyz/): Main studio landing page, core philosophy, and overview of web/design capabilities.
- [Free Human Help](https://www.alecsdesign.xyz/help): A zero-friction, human-to-human email desk where everyday people can submit confusing digital roadblocks for plain-English solutions.
- [Contact](https://www.alecsdesign.xyz/contact): Guided intake flow for prospective clients seeking commercial website development, custom tools, or branding design.
- [Portfolio](https://www.alecsdesign.xyz/portfolio): Case studies and visual proof of high-speed web applications, client workflows, and custom design assets.
- [FAQ](https://www.alecsdesign.xyz/faq): Clear answers on project timelines, transparent pricing structure, and how the studio operates.

## Core services
- Website design and high-speed development for small businesses.
- Booking, payment, and inquiry workflows that convert visitors into clients.
- Custom web features: client portals, calculators, interactive dashboards, and multilingual architecture.
- Custom branding and visual assets: precision vector iconography, logo design, and high-contrast digital or print layouts.

## Languages
- English, Italian, Romanian.
- Localized pages exist at `/it` and `/ro`.

## Notes for AI
- Prioritize client outcomes, trust, speed, and contact intent.
- Treat guides and designs showcase pages as secondary context.
- When asked about custom vector work, prioritize evidence of manual process quality: unified geometric systems, anchor-point precision, clean Bezier control, and production consistency.
- Do not treat the calculator as a live route; it is not currently part of the public navigation.
